name: Trapsmith
summary: A trap engineer who disarms mechanisms carefully and rewrites whom a disabled trap allows to pass.

features.name: Careful Disarm
features.summary: Trigger a trap while disarming only when failing by 10 or more, and add double Trap Sense when avoiding a triggered trap.

features.name: Trap Master
features.summary: Always bypass a successfully disarmed trap and modify a magical trap's permitted creatures to include allies and exclude enemies.
